sections.written: Body handbook/parts/p03/random-structures-and-limit-laws-w03-p03-065.tex 1-639: G(n,p(n)), almost sure/never, <<,>>, threshold functions and their limits; proved thresholds thm:p03-w03-p03-065-clique, -isolated, -connectivity (Erdos-Renyi window e^{-e^{-c}}, new), -common-neighbour; path-of-length-three threshold via \cref{thm:p03-w03-p03-064-path3}; p=n^{-alpha} regime with thm:p03-w03-p03-065-shelah-spencer now proved=annex (AS_alpha from thm:p03-w03-p03-068-nonexistence and the new generic extension theorem, then thm:p03-w03-p03-072-sparse-zero-one); Ext(R,H), dense/sparse/rigid/safe, pi/7 examples, Harris, Janson, almost-sure criterion thm:p03-w03-p03-065-safe-criterion; new section sec:p03-w03-p03-065-counting: def:p03-w03-p03-065-exponent, thm:p03-w03-p03-065-decomposition, thm:p03-w03-p03-065-counting (source's large deviation / Counting Theorem, o(n^{-r}) form), thm:p03-w03-p03-065-rigid-count, thm:p03-w03-p03-065-upper-count, thm:p03-w03-p03-065-generic-extension, def:p03-w03-p03-065-generic-example, def:p03-w03-p03-065-generic-limits; relationships \cref the countable-model classification (thm:p03-w03-p03-067-categorical, thm:p03-w03-p03-067-sparse-models). Annex handbook/annex/p03/random-structures-and-limit-laws-w03-p03-065.tex 1-786: complete proofs for every proved= result.
remaining: Dependency, not written here (A14): the non-aleph_0-categoricity of T_alpha for irrational alpha is on the route only as thm:p03-w03-p03-067-sparse-models with sketched=; its complete proof is component C007 of readonly unit ED26-SRC-050-0004 owned by w03a-p03-064. The counting estimate that 067's sketch names as missing is now thm:p03-w03-p03-065-counting.

The source's exp(-n^eps) remark (p. 10) for the count is not proved; the count is proved with failure o(n^{-r}), which is the form the source states and uses; the exponential bound is proved only for existence (thm:p03-w03-p03-065-safe-criterion).
